controls: Declared bounded search only; no global-optimality claim
All saved LP inputs replayed without physics by the verifier
falsification: All seeds floor with full residual clearly above tolerance and no certification passes gate 3.
hypothesis: Either the full residual descends to tolerance (an approximate-support witness satisfying all constraints within solver resolution) or it floors well above, completing the negative result at the physically meaningful level.

parameters.descent_dofs: every non-root DOF row (actuated and passive) plus three world-frame root-rotation axes; root x,y are dead by translation symmetry and root z is re-derived per probe
parameters.descent_rule: deterministic cyclic coordinate descent: joint DOFs in row order then rotation axes x,y,z; rotations applied as world-frame axis-angle premultiplications; probes exceeding max_root_tilt_rad from the seed orientation are rejected without evaluation
parameters.objective: FULL-system minimum scaled balance error (all 72 rows including tendon rows within declared tension limits) with LIVE contact re-derivation per probe; minimum over the depth grid, no root-balance pre-gate
parameters.scope: Static witness generation; a tolerance witness is a force assignment satisfying all declared inequality constraints with equality residual within solver resolution — not exact LP feasibility, not a standing or dynamic claim
parameters.verification: replay of saved-input LPs in the same SciPy/HiGHS family; no independent physics or biological check

question: Descending the full 72-row support residual (not just the tension-free subsystem) over all joint DOFs and bounded root tilt under live contacts: does any pose reach the declared residual tolerance, or does the full system floor nonzero?
success_criterion: An accepted or terminal pose reaches full scaled residual <= 1e-6, or strict feasibility is certified.
